fees.note: From the park's rates page (read 2026-10-13): full-hookup sites from $35 a night, $200 a week or $465 a month; electric is included except on long-term stays, and tax is extra.  A 'Weekender Special' prices an RV site at $250 for 'a 2-week, 3 weekend stay from Friday to Monday'.  The park books through ParkWithUs; its Campspot listing has shown it closed since June 2022.

source: https://theweekender-plainview.com/rates/ (daily, weekly and monthly rates for the full-hookup RV sites), read 2026-10-13

_patch.note: Read on the Campspot marketplace: one night for 2 adults, site rate before tax, every RV site type a 23-ft rig fits (Rustic RV - Waterfront, 30/50 Amp RV and 30/50 Amp RV Waterfront). October 2026: $20-30, Tuesday and Saturday alike. June 2027 isn't open for booking yet. Plus the county's $7 'Booking Fee', once per stay. Campspot adds its own booking fee at checkout (3%, at least $3). Read 2026-10-13. The county's own page gives the same rates, $30 a night for an electric site in A Loop and $20 for a non-electric one in B Loop, and says the $7 fee is added once per reservation, not per night.
_patch.source_add: ; https://www.itascacountymn.gov/282/Bass-Lake-County-Park-and-Campground (Campground Fees and the $7 booking fee), read 2026-10-13

fees.note: From the city's rates page (read 2026-10-13): sites with electric only (20/30 amp, rigs up to 35 feet) $34 Sunday to Thursday and $39 on Friday and Saturday, or $36 and $41 from June through September; full-hookup sites (20/30/50 amp) $47 and $50, or $49 and $52 from June through September.  By the week, $209 with electric only and $285 with full hookups.  Campspot's booking engine, closed for the season from October 11, 2026, quoted the same $34 and $47 for October 20, plus a $2 'Reservation Fee' once per stay.  The city's page also lists a $10 non-refundable reservation fee, a $10 fee to change a reservation and an optional $10 to lock in a chosen site.

source: https://www.blackbeachcampground.com/campground (Campsite Rates by season and day of the week, weekly rates, reservation and extra fees), read 2026-10-13; https://www.campspot.com/park/black-beach-municipal-campground (quotes for 2026-10-20 while the park is closed: $34 and $47 plus a $2 'Reservation Fee', which a two-night search shows is charged once per stay; campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl, campspot_dates.py), read 2026-10-13

fees.note: From the county's page (read 2026-10-13): full-hookup sites $50 a night, water-and-electric sites $40 and rustic sites $20, plus a $7 booking fee once per reservation, not per night.  After the water to the sites is shut off on October 15, Campspot sold the hookup sites for $30 and the rustic ones for $20 (October 17 and 20, 2026).  Campspot adds its own booking fee at checkout (3%, at least $3).

source: https://www.itascacountymn.gov/284/Fairgrounds-Park-and-Campground (Campground Fees: full hookup, water and electric, rustic; the $7 booking fee; water off October 15), read 2026-10-13; https://www.campspot.com/park/fairgrounds-park-campground-grandrapids-mn (Campspot's pricing for each RV site type, one night from 2026-10-17 and 2026-10-20, 2 adults; campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl), read 2026-10-13
